rust_summary: IME composition and commit notifications for mod screens, plus mod-owned IME enablement and candidate-window placement (`native_ime_preedit`, `native_ime_commit`, `native_ime_set_allowed`, `native_ime_set_cursor_area`).
doc_summary: While a mod screen is open, `ime_preedit(text, cursor)` reports the live composition and its optional byte-offset cursor range, and `ime_commit(text)` reports committed text before the ordinary screen character hooks. An empty preedit clears the composition. The owner calls `ime_set_allowed(allowed)` to enable or disable the OS input method and `ime_set_cursor_area([x, y, width, height])` to place its candidate window in GUI-scaled coordinates. These hooks do not fire on vanilla screens, and the services require the calling mod's own open screen. Bundles need fragment @API:ime@.
